description: Saves a message as a draft in a conversation's draft box, as the draft box and /drafts New draft do: give conversationId, or clientId to use that contact's one conversation. channel 'email' with a subject, a picked recipient or replyToEmailId makes an email reply; otherwise it is a text. whyNote is the line shown above the draft. Nothing is sent; a person reviews the exact text and presses Send. For a plain text draft the Sergio card's own create_draft does the same. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat returns the original draft.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: compose_draft
title: Save a draft in a conversation's draft box
